annotations.title: Place an image in a Brilliant design

description: Use this when the user wants an image (one they attached, or one generated in this conversation) placed into a Brilliant design opened in this conversation: it puts the image on the canvas as an editable image layer, or as the fill of a target layer, and answers how it applied. It takes the design's seed and the image as image (the file attached or generated in the conversation), imageUrl (https) or imageBase64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 25 MB); target names an existing frame or shape by its id or #ref to fill instead.

image.description: The image attached to or generated in the conversation.

imageBase64.description: The image's bytes as base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 25 MB).

imageUrl.description: An https URL of the image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 25 MB).

name.description: The new image layer's name (default Image).

seed.description: The slug of a design opened in this conversation (from the design result).

target.description: The id or #ref of an existing frame or shape in the design whose fill becomes the image; its size and position stay. Without it, the image lands as a new layer.

name: place_image
title: Place an image in a Brilliant design
